article.headline: Dotzler’s 18 lead South Dakota over Arkansas-Pine Bluff 86-50
article.description: — Josiah Dotzler had 18 points in South Dakota’s 86-50 win over Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Dotzler’s 18 lead South Dakota over Arkansas-Pine Bluff 86-50

keywords: Arkansas-Pine Bluff Golden Lions @ South Dakota Coyotes
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Josiah Dotzler had 18 points in South Dakota’s 86-50 win over Arkansas-Pine Bluff on Wednesday. Dotzler shot 7 of 10 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line for the Coyotes (4-5). Vince Buzelis scored 14 points and added six rebounds. Cade Kelderman went 5 of 7 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. Jalen Tatum led the Golden Lions (0-7) in scoring, finishing with 15 points. Macaleab Rich added 13 points and seven rebounds for UAPB. C.J. Smith finished with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
